text: Show Full Path is available only when compact display is enabled and an active mode supports compact rows. Mode changes and compact commands update availability; opening the menu also refreshes its checked and enabled state. The command persists the visibility option and recalculates rows. Only both-style visible folder-and-server names use that choice; fullName keeps the full path for the separate accessible-label path. This is a scoped source contract, not a UI or screen-reader test result.
title: Show Full Path refreshes compact-mode availability when the folder menu opens
